title: vilfa roxburghii

It is native to the Himalayas and is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Vilfa roxburghii include its ability to treat various digestive issues, such as constipation and diarrhea, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help reduce stress and promote overall well-being.
